# Data Source nexus_http_client
~> **PRO Feature** (Nexus Repository Pro)

Use this data source to query Nexus system HTTP/HTTPS proxy settings
## Example Usage
```terraform
data "nexus_http_client" "config" {}

output "http_proxy_host" {
  value = data.nexus_http_client.config.http_proxy[0].host
}
```
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `http_proxy` (List of Object) HTTP proxy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http_proxy))
- `https_proxy` (List of Object) HTTPS proxy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--https_proxy))
- `id` (String) Used to identify data source at nexus
- `non_proxy_hosts` (Set of String) Host patterns that should bypass the HTTP/HTTPS proxy.
- `retries` (Number) Number of retries for outbound HTTP requests.
- `timeout` (Number) Connection/request timeout in seconds.
- `user_agent` (String) Custom User-Agent suffix for outbound HTTP requests.
